originalSummary: EMA announced an ongoing review of Deanxit, the flupentixol/melitracen combination for depression and anxiety, after neurological and psychiatric reports involving movement and cognitive problems. Some reportedly persisted after withdrawal. The agency is examining severity, duration, possible irreversibility and the benefit of the combination; these concerns are not a completed causal or incidence assessment. Flupentixol-only medicines are explicitly outside this review. No Tourette-specific efficacy, risk estimate, patient applicability or class-wide conclusion is established. No treatment change follows from this notebook.
